text: | Local IPC access (driver session socket) | No handshake, token, secret or peer-credential check: access is the filesystem's — the state directory is created `0700`, a present one open to its group or to others is refused (`StateDirNotPrivate`), and the socket file is set `0600`, so only the owning user reaches it; `start` does not check that the answering pid is the child it spawned (packages/escher-driver/src/host.rs:91-102; packages/escher-driver/src/host.rs:124) | `std` file modes (unix) |
